image_description: A low-angle shot of a rock band performing on an outdoor stage under a tent structure. Three musicians are visible: a vocalist in a white hoodie on the left, a bassist in a leather jacket and hat in the center, and a guitarist on the right. The foreground is dominated by large black stage monitors (speakers). Overhead, there is a metal truss system with stage lights and bunting flags.

The immediate front edge of the stage is heavily occluded by large wedge monitors and equipment cases in the foreground, preventing a clear view of the proscenium line or skirt.
